commands.command:
install -d -m 0755 /opt/inventory-lb
cat > /opt/inventory-lb/proxy.py <<'ANTRIEB_PROXY_EOF'
#!/usr/bin/python3
import http.client
import threading
from http.server import BaseHTTPRequestHandler, ThreadingHTTPServer

BACKENDS = [("10.100.194.11", 8080), ("10.100.194.12", 8080)]
counter = 0
counter_lock = threading.Lock()
HOP_HEADERS = {"connection", "keep-alive", "proxy-authenticate", "proxy-authorization", "te", "trailers", "transfer-encoding", "upgrade"}

def backend_order():
    global counter
    with counter_lock:
        start = counter
        counter = (counter + 1) % len(BACKENDS)
    return BACKENDS[start:] + BACKENDS[:start]

class ProxyHandler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    protocol_version = "HTTP/1.1"

    def do_GET(self):
        errors = []
        for host, port in backend_order():
            conn = http.client.HTTPConnection(host, port, timeout=3)
            try:
                conn.request("GET", self.path, headers={"Host": self.headers.get("Host", ""), "X-Forwarded-For": self.client_address[0]})
                response = conn.getresponse()
                body = response.read()
                self.send_response(response.status)
                for name, value in response.getheaders():
                    if name.lower() not in HOP_HEADERS and name.lower() != "content-length":
                        self.send_header(name, value)
                self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(body)))
                self.send_header("X-Load-Balancer", "node1")
                self.end_headers()
                self.wfile.write(body)
                return
            except Exception as exc:
                errors.append("%s:%s=%s" % (host, port, exc))
            finally:
                conn.close()
        body = ("no healthy inventory backends: " + "; ".join(errors) + "\n").encode("utf-8")
        self.send_response(503)
        self.send_header("Content-Type", "text/plain; charset=utf-8")
        self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(body)))
        self.end_headers()
        self.wfile.write(body)

    def log_message(self, fmt, *args):
        print("%s - %s" % (self.address_string(), fmt % args), flush=True)

ThreadingHTTPServer(("0.0.0.0", 80), ProxyHandler).serve_forever()
ANTRIEB_PROXY_EOF
chmod 0755 /opt/inventory-lb/proxy.py
cat > /etc/systemd/system/inventory-lb.service <<'ANTRIEB_LB_UNIT_EOF'
[Unit]
Description=Inventory HTTP load balancer

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
ANTRIEB_LB_UNIT_EOF
